actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The titan makes three Husk Lance attacks.

actions.name: Husk Lance
actions.description: Macro Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage (macro: 42 piercing).

actions.name: Elimination Cannon
actions.description: Macro Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 240/720 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) radiant damage (macro: 45 radiant). A blast erupts around the target: each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on the target (including the target) must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw (macro), taking 31 (4d12 + 5) force damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success (macro: 53 force).

actions.name: Meteor Pitch
actions.description: The titan throws one creature it is grappling into a space it can see within 60 feet (plus an additional 30 feet for each size category smaller than Huge they are). This is made as a Macro Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, targeting both the thrown creature and any creature occupying the targeted space. On a hit, both creatures take 26 (4d12) bludgeoning damage and are knocked prone (macro: 48 bludgeoning).

bonus_actions.name: Capture Strike
bonus_actions.description: The titan makes one Husk Lance attack against a Huge or smaller creature within range. On a success the creature takes no damage, but is restrained and grappled (escape DC 19). While grappled this way, the titan can move freely with the creature in tow, but they make one fewer Husk Lance attack with their Multiattack. The titan may grapple up to two creatures this way.

legendary_reactions.source_conversion_note: Converted from Legendary Resistance (2/Day) per standing formatting rule.
